You told us you hate hidden fees and we listened. Bid or Buy it Now with confidence knowing that there are no hidden fees. We ship all items within the United States for a flat rate of one penny.
Details & Condition
This is a mixed lot of five smoking pipes featuring several distinct styles and materials, making it an interesting group for collectors, display, restoration, or parts use. The lot includes two matching glossy brown bent pipes, a carved wooden pipe with a bird motif and multicolor decorative wrap, a small black pipe with light-colored accent bands, and a long carved dark-tone pipe with sculpted facial details.
The two larger bent pipes have matching shapes and finishes with rounded bowls, black stems, and metal-tone accent rings at the shank. The carved wooden pipe features a detailed bird carving along the stem and decorative green, yellow, red, and black wrapping. The black pipe includes contrasting light-colored bands and a decorative inlay-style accent on the bowl. The long carved pipe has a central bowl and carved faces integrated into the body.
This lot offers a variety of designs that display well together and may appeal to pipe collectors, folk art enthusiasts, or buyers seeking unique decorative pieces. No maker marks are visible in the provided view.
This item is pre-owned. Please see photos for additional information.

279562639.description:
A single bookend cut from a half agate geode from Brazil, with a polished face showing white and gray quartz crystal banded by tan and rust colored agate. The rough natural rind is left on the curved outer edge, and the flat cut side stands upright without a base. A small oval foil label reading semi precious stones made in Brazil and a handwritten paper tag are affixed to one side, and a teal felt pad is attached to the bottom. Sold as a single piece, not a pair.

Condition: Natural pits, chips and mineral roughness along the uncut rind. The felt bottom pad is worn and soiled, and the paper label is aged with a torn corner.

279971113.description:
Natural Formation
Amethyst and Quartz Crystal Geode Lot
Natural Mineral Specimens
Approx. 5.5" x 4" and 4" x 2.5"
Unsigned
This lot features two distinct geological specimens, showcasing the natural beauty of crystalline formations. The first is a classic hollow quartz geode with a textured dark matrix opening to reveal a cavity of sparkling white crystals. The second is an amethyst cluster specimen featuring light purple crystalline structures atop a layered agate and rock base. Together, these pieces provide a compelling study of mineral growth and make for excellent decorative display pieces or additions to a rock and mineral collection.
Total combined weight of 3.1 lbs as confirmed by digital scale measurement
One specimen features a distinct amethyst cluster with lavender-hued points and visible agate banding
Exterior bases include minor inventory markings in red and purple ink from previous cataloging
Largest specimen measures approximately 5.5 inches in length based on visual scale
Condition:
Very good natural condition. The crystals remain sharp and intact with no significant damage to the points or facets. The exterior rocky matrices are stable and structurally sound. Note the presence of red and purple ink markings on the base and side of the specimens.
